verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Dropbox has public plans and plan-comparison pages, but the quoted items list only per-plan features such as transfer size limits and file-restore windows. None of the cited content shows per-plan storage quotas, per-user prices, or what happens when a user hits the storage cap. The existence of a plans page is adjacent to this story, not evidence that it publishes the required pricing details.

support.subject: As a founder, storage pricing is published — per-plan storage quotas and per-user prices on a public page, including what happens at the cap
